tasks.title: Fix planner validate_plan: external-build module-creating false positive plus cd-prefixed verification_command rejection
acceptance_criteria: _is_module_creating gains an OPTIONAL working_dir=None parameter and resolves relative files_touched paths against effective_target_root(working_dir) instead of the hardcoded `repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]`; every other line of the function (including the full docstring) is byte-identical to the staged target.

When working_dir is None, effective_target_root(None) returns PROJECT_ROOT (the JM root), so the JM-self path is byte-equivalent: an existing JM module resolves -> not module-creating (False); an absent module -> module-creating (True).

For an external build (plan working_dir set to another repo), an EDIT of an EXISTING external file (e.g. noblegreed/adapter.py) is NOT treated as module-creating and does NOT emit missing_wiring_oracle.
For an external build, an ABSENT external file is STILL module-creating and STILL emits missing_wiring_oracle.

validate_plan reads `wd = plan.get('working_dir')` ONCE near the top of the body (after `tasks = plan.get('tasks', [])`, before the per-task loop) and passes it via `_is_module_creating(task, working_dir=wd)` at the existing module-creating check; validate_plan's signature stays `validate_plan(plan)`.

Inside the same per-task loop (no new top-level helper), validate_plan emits PlanViolation('cd_prefixed_verification_command', ...) when verification_command is a str beginning with a `cd ` or embedding `&& cd `/`; cd `/`| cd ` re-root.
A benign verification_command (e.g. `python -m pytest ... -q`) does NOT emit cd_prefixed_verification_command.

`from harness.paths import effective_target_root` is present at module top (added only if absent in the staged target's import block); `import re` (already present at line 3) is reused — no second import added.

No new top-level symbol/helper is added; no other symbol in plan_validator.py (_is_wiring_oracle, _valid_mutation_module, check_missing_fields, validate_epic_plan, the cycle DFS, validate_plan_wrapper) and no other file is touched.

spec.objective: Fix two plan-time validation bugs in harness/planner/plan_validator.py via an in-place partial EDIT of exactly two existing module-level functions, _is_module_creating and validate_plan. (FIX A) _is_module_creating must resolve relative files_touched paths against the effective target root for the plan's working_dir, so an EDIT of an existing EXTERNAL file is not falsely classified module-creating and no longer triggers a spurious missing_wiring_oracle. (FIX C) validate_plan must reject at plan time any verification_command that begins with or embeds a `cd ` re-rooting the shell, which would otherwise override the worker's staging-worktree cwd and silently produce auto_commit_failed.
functional_requirements: EDIT 1 — _is_module_creating: change the signature to `def _is_module_creating(task: Any, working_dir=None) -> bool:` and replace the resolution base line `repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]` with `repo_root = effective_target_root(working_dir)`; keep the full docstring and every other line of the function byte-identical to the staged target. effective_target_root(None) returns PROJECT_ROOT, preserving JM-self behavior byte-equivalently.

EDIT 2a — validate_plan: read `wd = plan.get('working_dir')` ONCE near the top of the function body (after `tasks = plan.get('tasks', [])`, before the per-task loop) and thread it through the existing module-creating check as `if _is_module_creating(task, working_dir=wd) and not _is_wiring_oracle(task.get('verification_command')):`; validate_plan's signature stays `validate_plan(plan)`.

EDIT 2b — validate_plan: INLINE inside the same per-task loop (after meta_task_type validation, NO new top-level helper), add: `vcmd = task.get('verification_command')` then if it is a str matching `re.match(r'\s*cd\s', vcmd)` or `re.search(r'(?:^|&&|;|\|)\s*cd\s', vcmd)`, append PlanViolation('cd_prefixed_verification_command', f'{path_prefix}.verification_command', <re-root diagnostic message>).

Wiring/imports — ensure `from harness.paths import effective_target_root` is present at module top (add the single import line only if absent in the staged target's import block); reuse the already-present `import re` (line 3); add no other import and no new top-level symbol; touch no other symbol or file. All untouched lines of both functions and the rest of plan_validator.py remain byte-identical to the staged target.
spec.interfaces: in-place EDIT of harness/planner/plan_validator.py — TWO existing module-level functions only. (A) _is_module_creating gains an OPTIONAL working_dir=None param and resolves relative files_touched paths against effective_target_root(working_dir) (imported from harness.paths) instead of the hardcoded JM repo_root; working_dir=None keeps the JM-self behavior byte-identical. (B) inside validate_plan, read `wd = plan.get('working_dir')` once and pass it to the existing _is_module_creating(task) call (-> _is_module_creating(task, working_dir=wd)); and, in the same per-task loop, emit a PlanViolation code 'cd_prefixed_verification_command' when the task's verification_command is a str matching a leading or embedded `cd ` re-root (INLINE — no new top-level helper). NO signature change to validate_plan; NO other symbol touched. partial_edit semantics: a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ list with EXACTLY TWO 'symbol' entries — '_is_module_creating' and 'validate_plan' — each reproduced byte-for-byte from the staged read-only target at /home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR_agentwork/claude/claude-r1-notask-edc8e6ea/inbox/targets/harness/planner/plan_validator.py, changing only the lines described.
edge_cases: external existing file with working_dir set -> NOT module-creating, no missing_wiring_oracle.
external ABSENT file with working_dir set -> STILL module-creating, missing_wiring_oracle emitted.
JM-self case (working_dir None) -> _is_module_creating behavior byte-identical (existing module False, absent module True).
embedded `; cd ` re-root vcmd -> cd_prefixed_verification_command emitted.
benign `python -m pytest ... -q` vcmd -> cd_prefixed_verification_command NOT emitted.
non_goals: Behavior-only EDIT; integration testing of the end-to-end planner/daemon dispatch flow is OUT OF SCOPE (the integration-test requirement is excused — the two pre-committed oracle files plus the JM-self invariant assertion are the full contract).
Does NOT change the SIGNATURE of validate_plan (it stays validate_plan(plan)); only its body reads plan.get('working_dir') and adds the cd check inline.
Does NOT add any new top-level symbol/helper function; the cd check is implemented INLINE inside validate_plan's existing per-task loop.
Does NOT change _is_module_creating's behavior when working_dir is None/absent (JM-self path MUST stay byte-identical).
Does NOT touch any other symbol in plan_validator.py (_is_wiring_oracle, _valid_mutation_module, check_missing_fields, validate_epic_plan, the cycle DFS, validate_plan_wrapper) or any other file.
Does NOT author new tests — the two pre-committed RED oracle files are the authoritative contract.
